articles.title: Iran Claims Two Oil Supertankers Explode After Striking Naval Mines While Crossing Strait Of Hormuz Through 'Unauthorized' Routes | Video
articles.description: Iran claimed two oil supertankers exploded after hitting naval mines near the Strait of Hormuz and said it shot down a US MQ-1 Predator drone. The IRGC also claimed responsibility for retaliatory strikes targeting US radar systems at two air bases in Bahrain.

articles.title: Iran strike wounds two in Bahrain, Saudi condemns 'criminal' attacks
articles.description: MANAMA - Bahrain said on Sunday that two people were wounded in an Iranian strike the previous day on "a civilian industrial site" in the Gulf kingdom, which has faced several attacks this week.
